articleClaim: Bulk-trained uMLIPs systematically soften energies in under-coordinated environments that govern water and air materials; a measured coordination-specific runtime correction restores trustworthy binding, barrier, and ranking predictions.
explanatoryPurpose: Make the causal chain visible: coordination drops, the raw energy surface softens, rankings invert, and the measured runtime correction restores the ordering while preserving explicit epistemic boundaries.
